summary: This week's technology updates highlight key advancements in AI models and engineering platforms alongside critical cybersecurity vulnerabilities affecting Linux systems, developer tooling, and mobile applications.

items.title: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary: Anthropic introduced its new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models designed to handle complex coding, reasoning, and vision tasks. The release aims to help developers tackle challenging software engineering and scientific problems more quickly.

items.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
items.summary: A setting in Claude Code has led to thousands of sensitive credentials, including API keys and passwords, being inadvertently published to GitHub repositories. This security risk highlights critical challenges in developer tooling and automated AI configuration.

items.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
items.summary: Hardware engineering AI platform startup Nominal raised a new funding round that tripled its valuation to $3 billion in eight months. The company serves major clients like Anduril to streamline engineering workflows using artificial intelligence.

items.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
items.summary: A critical security flaw allowing unauthorized SSH access to Linux devices is currently under active exploitation by attackers. The vulnerability poses a severe threat to internet security and enterprise infrastructure.

items.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
items.summary: Wyndham left hardcoded credentials inside its customer application, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive customer data. The incident underscores significant vulnerabilities in mobile application security and data protection.
